pain_points.statement: The custom dispatch tool, Routemaster, has severe technical debt preventing feature shipping.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Technical debt in Routemaster. We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

pain_points.statement: Changes to the codebase take three times longer than they should.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Every change takes three times as long as it should.

desired_state.source_excerpt: replace Routemaster with a SaaS platform
desired_state.contradiction_note: The CTO wants a full SaaS platform replacement, while the VP of Ops wants incremental workflow fixes on the existing platform.

desired_state.statement: Build workflow logic in a portable layer on top of the existing system.

success_criteria.statement: 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a future platform change.
